messages:
Samir K.: FYI — follow-up from the Sentinel health security review earlier today. They sent back a few clarifying asks around RBAC, audit retention, KMS options, and how we handle vuln triage/IR. I captured them in the spreadsheet and put the recording in the thread. Need owners for each item; they want details by EOD Wed.
Jia L.: thanks. can you drop the sheet link?
Samir K.: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link-sentinel-sq (sheet: tabs = 'questions','answers','evidence')
Elaine P.: quick read: three high-priority asks — 1) scoped RBAC docs and admin separation for tenant ops, 2) audit log retention + export path to SIEM (2yr retention), 3) support for customer-managed KMS (AWS & GCP) with HSM-backed keys.
Mike R.: i'll own the RBAC write-up. plan is to document groups + least-privilege roles for Sentinels' dedicated tenant: `sentinel-admins`, `sentinel-observers`, `sentinel-deploy`. will add example IAM mappings and policy snippets.
Jia L.: i'll handle KMS integration notes. short answer: we support envelope encryption. customer CMK wraps our service key; we rotate wrapping key per their schedule; HSM -> AWS KMS / GCP KMS allowed. will include acceptance tests.
Samir K.: can you include a sample config they can paste into their onboarding doc?
Jia L.: yes. sample snippet below (they asked for concrete code):
```
# envelope config (example)
provider: "aws-kms"
cmk_arn: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:alias/sentinel-cmk"
wrap_algorithm: "kms-aes-wrap"
rotate_wrap_key: "30d"
```
I'll also note we support bring-your-own-key (BYOK) with key-signing proof and key-version audit.
Elaine P.: for audit logs — we will provide signed, append-only logs via our audit pipeline. retention configurable up to 36 months; default exported retention to SIEM: 24 months per ask. we'll document the S3/GCS export path and sample Kinesis/BigQuery ingestion.
Mike R.: snippet to ship to their SIEM (elk)
```
# audit export example
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit/sentinel/2025-03-01/ logs/ --recursive
# or push to Kinesis -> lambda -> ELK
```
Samir K.: vuln triage / IR question — they want our SLA for critical CVEs and objective evidence for mitigation steps.
Elaine P.: triage process summary: initial Triage within 1h (critical), patch/workaround within 24h or mitigation if patch not available, full RCA within 7d for prod-impacting issues. include links to vuln tracker ticket template and proof artifacts.
Mike R.: will add a sample incident playbook section for them: escalation path, P0/P1 owners, contact matrix (Slack handles + PD).
Samir K.: PD rotation — can we show an example of who would be on-call for Sentinel tenant incidents? they want explicit names/roles (not necessarily real staff, but a process).
Jia L.: we'll show role-based on-call: "tenant-ops" pager -> infra-oncall -> sec-oncall. include runbook that maps to our Notional PD schedule.
security-bot: Meeting recording and transcript uploaded: https://meetings.redwood/mock/sentinel/rec-1749532167
incident-bot: New ticket created: RED-INC-5212 (triage required) assigned to @mike_r
Elaine P.: Assignments so far: RBAC doc = @Mike R. KMS integration + config = @Jia L. Audit export & retention evidence = @Elaine P. Vulnerability/IR playbook = @Mike R. Samir to consolidate answers and send to Sentinel.
Samir K.: thanks — i'll draft the response today and ping for final reviews. target: send to customer by 2025-03-05 17:00 UTC. Please add any constraints in the sheet.
Jia L.: quick Q on one edge: customer asked whether we support HSM attestation docs (e.g., CloudHSM). We have a standard attestation template for HSM providers — i'll attach that to the sheet.
Mike R.: noted — i'll include the RBAC JSON sample and a minimal least-privilege policy for their IAM team to copy.
Elaine P.: also leaving a note: redact user PII from exported logs by default; we provide a regex-based redaction pipeline and can deliver proof of redaction on request.
Samir K.: perfect. if no objections i'll mark the sheet as 'ready-for-review' by EOD today. thanks all :thumbsup:
Jia L.: :+1:
Mike R.: :thumbsup:
Elaine P.: :rocket:
